## 改动 / Change

说明具体问题、改变后的行为及受影响机型。
Explain the problem, resulting behavior and affected models.

## 验证 / Validation

列出实际执行的检查或实机观察，注明未验证部分。
List checks or hardware observations actually performed, and identify untested areas.

## 相关记录 / Related records

关联 Issue、机型档案或资料来源；没有可留空。
Link related issues, model records or sources, if applicable.

- [ ] 已核对目标分支及中英文记录 / Target branch and bilingual records checked
- [ ] 公开内容不含私人日志或受限二进制 / No private logs or restricted binary payloads
- [ ] 已保留源码版权及修改来源 / Source notices and provenance retained
